name: Vercel
whatYouLose: Global edge network with instant deploys
prompt: Build a simple deployment dashboard that: connects to a GitHub repo, runs `npm run build` on push, serves the output via nginx, shows deploy history with status/logs, and supports custom domains via Caddy. Single-server, no edge network. This replaces the dashboard, not the infrastructure.
notes: You don't vibecode a CDN. You vibecode a deploy button that shells out to git pull && npm run build.
